description: This file defines a web scraper class 'CarriesExperimentalKitchen' for extracting recipe data from the website carriesexperimentalkitchen.com, including equipment and ingredient groups.

classes.name: CarriesExperimentalKitchen
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe details from carriesexperimentalkitchen.com, including equipment and ingredient groups.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the host URL for the recipe website.

methods.name: equipment
methods.description: Extracts and returns a list of equipment needed for the recipe.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Extracts and returns ingredient groups, excluding equipment sections.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Extracts and returns a list of ingredients, excluding equipment.
